children: Brambles' latest update is seen by its bull at UBS as further support for their May upgrade on the stock, to buy from neutral. Analyst Andre Fromyhr acknowledges that the CHEP pallet operator didn't give much trading insight at its annual general meeting but thinks risks have modestly declined on management commentary. He tells clients in a note that the company appears to be on track, including on resolving repair-network constraints and technology rollout, which should improve market confidence that it can meet its annual guidance. UBS keeps a buy rating on the stock and a target price of 24.50 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.6% at A$21.35. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
